Lena Fischer recorded 427 reads during the review period, requiring 364 hours of work. This represents a rate of 1.2 reads per hour. The workload record provides the basis for the review of activity and output. It indicates the total number of reads completed and the time allocated to that work, allowing the level of activity to be considered alongside the quality findings below.

## Quality

A sample of 25 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 72.0 per cent. This result records the level of consistency identified through the checked sample and should be considered with the workload information reported above.

Priya Anand completed the review of the quality findings for Lena Fischer. The review documents the checked sample and the resulting agreement measure for the period.
